name: Disney Magic Connection
summary: Disney Magic Connection is an unreleased software for the Nintendo DS that was tested early 2008, with the intention of being used within Disney World theme parks. The software worked as a map of the park, which has GPS capabilities to showcase the placement of the user within the park, alongside showing locations of other parts of the park, including rides and characters about. In addition to working as an interactive map, it also included features such as allowing the user to create to-do lists and an interactive trivia quiz.
